Class Parser

java.lang.Object
math.parser.Parser
public class Parser extends Object

Name: Parser

Description: Simple Java arithmetic expression parser and ELL(1) grammar syntactical analyzer and evaluator. Parser supports detection of implicit multiplication when a constant is followed by a variable or function.

Grammar:
S -> E (('+' | '-') E)*
E -> G ('*' G)*
G -> H ('/' H)*
H -> T ('%' T)*
T -> F | '-' F
F -> U ('^' U)*
U -> function '(' S ')' | number | '(' S ')' | variable
